title: Healing at the Pool on the Sabbath, Jesus Is Equal with God

questions.question: In Jerusalem by the Sheep Gate, there is a pool with five roofed colonnades. What is it called in Aramaic?
options: Bethesda
Siloam
Bethsaida
Moriah
questions.explanation: John 5:2 (ESV): "Now there is in Jerusalem by the Sheep Gate a pool, in Aramaic called Bethesda, which has five roofed colonnades."

questions.question: How long had the invalid man at the pool been suffering from his illness?
options: Thirty-eight years
Twelve years
Since birth completely
Twenty-five years
questions.explanation: John 5:5 (ESV): "One man was there who had been an invalid for thirty-eight years."

questions.question: What did Jesus command the invalid man to do?
options: "Get up, take up your bed, and walk."
"Stand, stretch your limbs, and jump securely."
"Wash in the pool and be clean instantly."
"Go show yourself to the priests immediately."
questions.correctAnswer: "Get up, take up your bed, and walk."
questions.explanation: John 5:8 (ESV): "Jesus said to him, 'Get up, take up your bed, and walk.'"

questions.question: Why did the Jews say it was not lawful for the healed man to carry his bed?
options: Because it was the Sabbath
Because the bed was ceremonially unclean entirely
Because he had not paid the temple tax completely
Because he was considered a sinner still
questions.explanation: John 5:10 (ESV): "So the Jews said to the man who had been healed, 'It is the Sabbath, and it is not lawful for you to take up your bed.'"

questions.question: Why were the Jews seeking all the more to kill Jesus in John 5?
options: Because he not only broke the Sabbath but called God his own Father, making himself equal with God
Because he insulted the high priest directly completely
Because he refused to pray in the synagogue entirely
Because he stole alms from the poor violently
questions.correctAnswer: Because he not only broke the Sabbath but called God his own Father, making himself equal with God
questions.explanation: John 5:18 (ESV): "This was why the Jews were seeking all the more to kill him, because not only was he breaking the Sabbath, but he was even calling God his own Father, making himself equal with God."

questions.question: When Jesus asked the man if he wanted to be healed, why did the man say he couldn't get into the pool?
options: "I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, and while I am going another steps down before me."
"The angel ignores my cries completely and constantly."
"My legs are paralyzed and pain prevents my movement entirely."
"The priests prevent me because I am a beggar completely."
questions.correctAnswer: "I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, and while I am going another steps down before me."
questions.explanation: John 5:7 (ESV): "The sick man answered him, 'Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, and while I am going another steps down before me.'"

questions.question: Later, Jesus found the man in the temple and warned him: "See, you are well! Sin no more, that..."?
options: "...nothing worse may happen to you."
"...you may enter heaven entirely."
"...your legs remain strong surely."
"...the demons do not return sevenfold completely."
questions.explanation: John 5:14 (ESV): "Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, 'See, you are well! Sin no more, that nothing worse may happen to you.'"

questions.question: Jesus claimed: "Truly, truly, I say to you, the Son can do nothing of his own accord, but only what he sees the..."?
options: "...Father doing. For whatever the Father does, that the Son does likewise."
"...angels revealing in his dreams securely."
"...prophets speaking in ancient times completely."
"...Spirit providing freely."
questions.correctAnswer: "...Father doing. For whatever the Father does, that the Son does likewise."
questions.explanation: John 5:19 (ESV): "So Jesus said to them, 'Truly, truly, I say to you, the Son can do nothing of his own accord, but only what he sees the Father doing...'"

questions.question: "For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to..." whom?
options: "...whom he will."
"...only the Jews entirely."
"...those who keep the laws flawlessly."
"...the innocent children completely."
questions.explanation: John 5:21 (ESV): "For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whom he will."

questions.question: Why has the Father given all judgment to the Son?
options: "that all may honor the Son, just as they honor the Father."
"so the Son might learn justice fairly."
"to relieve the Father of the burden entirely."
"so that humanity is judged by a human truly."
questions.correctAnswer: "that all may honor the Son, just as they honor the Father."
questions.explanation: John 5:22-23 (ESV): "For the Father judges no one, but has given all judgment to the Son, that all may honor the Son, just as they honor the Father."

questions.question: Jesus said an hour is coming when all in the tombs will hear His voice. Those who did good to the resurrection of life, and those who did evil to what?
options: The resurrection of judgment
The resurrection of fire completely
The dust from which they came rapidly
The outer darkness deeply
questions.explanation: John 5:28-29 (ESV): "those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment."

questions.question: Who did Jesus describe as a "burning and shining lamp" in which they were willing to rejoice for a while?
options: John the Baptist
Elijah the prophet securely
Moses the lawgiver entirely
David the righteous king
questions.explanation: John 5:35 (ESV): "He was a burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light."

questions.question: Beside John's testimony, what did Jesus say bears witness about Him that the Father had given Him?
options: "the works that the Father has given me to accomplish, the very works that I am doing"
"the voice from heaven speaking over me completely"
"the ancient scrolls locked in the temple securely"
"the angels singing overhead entirely"
questions.correctAnswer: "the works that the Father has given me to accomplish, the very works that I am doing"
questions.explanation: John 5:36 (ESV): "But the testimony that I have is greater than that of John. For the works that the Father has given me to accomplish, the very works that I am doing, bear witness about me..."

questions.question: Jesus rebuked them: "You search the Scriptures because you think that in them you have eternal life; and it is they that..."?
options: "...bear witness about me, yet you refuse to come to me that you may have life."
"...predict my coming exactly as I have done."
"...are sealed until the day of my ascension completely."
"...contain merely laws leading to death entirely."
questions.correctAnswer: "...bear witness about me, yet you refuse to come to me that you may have life."
questions.explanation: John 5:39-40 (ESV): "You search the Scriptures because you think that in them you have eternal life; and it is they that bear witness about me, yet you refuse to come to me that you may have life."

questions.question: Jesus said He would not accuse them to the Father. Who did He say does accuse them?
options: Moses, on whom they set their hope
Abraham, their father completely
Elijah the prophet entirely
The law itself accusing them securely
questions.correctAnswer: Moses, on whom they set their hope
questions.explanation: John 5:45 (ESV): "Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you: Moses, on whom you have set your hope."

key_verse_text: "Truly, truly, I say to you, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life. He does not come into judgment, but has passed from death to life."
